message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card face‑up to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the **color**, the **number**, or the **action** of the top discard. 3. If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score. | | **Special Rules** | • **Uno** – When you have one card left, you must say “Uno” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so means you must draw two cards as a penalty.
• **Challenge** – If you suspect a player illegally played a Wild Draw Four, you can challenge. If correct, the challenger draws four cards; if wrong, the challenger draws six. | | **Variations** | Many house rules exist (e.g., “Stacking” where Draw Twos stack, “No Draw” variants, etc.). Clarify before starting. | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Setup**: Shuffle, deal 7 cards each, flip top card to start discard pile. 2. **Turn**: Play a matching card or draw. 3. **Action**: Follow the effect of any action card. 4. **Uno**: Say “Uno” when down to one card. 5. **Round End**: Last card discarded → score. 6. **Game End**: First to 500 points wins. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
